memory_candidates.content: TM⁺ schema soundness over an extended language can be discharged in one lemma by atomization: replace each state-formula operator instance (⊡χ) by a fresh atom via an injective encoding Atom ⊕ Formula' → Atom, build the atomized model on the same frame with an existential valuation, and prove a single truth-transfer induction; then the landed axiom_validIn/axiom_swap_validIn apply on the same frame so fc.Sat is inherited. Swap-validity needs the encoding conjugated by swapTemporal (Encoding.swap).

lake-build-guard.sh requires the lake subcommand AFTER the `--` separator: `lake-build-guard.sh build --timeout 1800 -- build <Module>`; omitting `build` after `--` exits 77. Editing any file imported (transitively) by Semantics.lean (e.g. Semantics/Star*.lean docstrings) triggers a ~5-15 min rebuild of the entire Metalogic tree, so batch docstring edits to those modules.

Paper anchor `app:non-deterministic` does not exist in possible_worlds.tex; the non-deterministic refutation of Determined is the second half of `app:deterministic` (LIVE-UNPINNED in specs/paper-definitions-of-record.md). C15 fails on the former.
